Advance Deposit, Processing Fee and Credit Card Fee:
A deposit of 20% (the "Advance Deposit") of the Minimum Spend will be charged at the time of booking. In addition to the Advance Deposit, non-refundable processing and credit card fees will also be charged at the time of booking. The Advance Deposit will be applied towards guest's final bill on the Booking Date. At time of check-in on the Booking Date, guests will be required to present the same method of payment as used when booking online or will be required to provide an alternative method of payment for their table/location.

All bookings will be charged the following on the Booking Date:

* Actual Spend: Guest will be charged the balance of the Actual Spend.

* Sales Tax: Guest will be charged sales tax, which is currently 8.375% and subject to change, on the Actual Spend + Venue Fee.

* Gratuity: Guest will be charged a waitress gratuity of 15%.

* Venue Fee: Guest will be charged a venue fee of 14% of the Actual Spend.

info.name: Athena Infinity Ultra Pool
info.tagline: Turn up the heat and indulge in relaxation at the Resorts World Las Vegas VIP Pool.
info.descr:
Resorts World Las Vegas's pool complex is the largest on the Strip with seven stunning pool experiences to choose from – providing plenty of room to lounge poolside, preferably while enjoying a hand-crafted cocktail, or two.

Poolside Food and Beverage – Resorts World Las Vegas offers four poolside food and beverage options across its expansive 5.5-acre pool complex. Satisfy your cravings at Agave Bar & Grill, serving Mediterranean fare and grilled seafood dishes, or grab something quick at Bites, a snack bar located at the Family Pool on the east side of the pool deck. Numerous full-service bars are available to quench your thirst – all serving an extensive menu of specialty cocktails. 

Retail – The shopping doesn't have to stop when you are poolside at Resorts World Las Vegas. Two pool sundries shops are available for guests to enjoy, including Sunkissed, selling all your summertime sunning needs and Swim Society, a swim apparel shop with a variety of bikinis, trunks, sunglasses and more.  


VIP Pool Description – Turn up the heat and indulge in relaxation at the Resorts World Las Vegas VIP Pool. This adult-only experience features two mesmerizing pools, including the Las Vegas Strip's only infinity pool with breathtaking skyline views. Lounge in this luxurious oasis with daybeds, cabanas, and a bar for all your poolside desires – all paired with lively music and refined service. Guests must be at least 21 years of age and reservations are required. 

VIP Pool FAQ

Do you offer Umbrellas for Rental? -  Umbrellas are not for sale but first come first serve.

Do you require guests to Reserve/Pay for Pool Seats? – The Main, Bimini, and Family pools do not reservations (excluding Cabanas and Daybeds). Chairs will be first come first serve at these pools. 

Can you take Food and Beverage Purchased at the pools outside the Pool Complex? Food and Beverage can leave the pool complex. The Pool Management Teams will limit each guest to one outside drink (not in a glass) and only food purchased in the hotel can come into the pool complex.

Can you explain the Fees and Charges for Resort Pools? Reservations at the RWLV Pool require a split of ½ Rental Fee and ½ F&B Minimum Spend plus a 20% Gratuity (10% Rental Fee, 10% F&B) and a 12.75% Venue Fee. Sales Tax is applied to the F&B as well as a CC Fee on the total transaction.

Numerous full-service bars are available to quench your thirst – all serving an extensive menu of specialty cocktails.

profile.name: DJ Snake
profile.bio:
If somewhere, in the vast expanse of the multiverse, there exists a planet where giant exotic birds twerk to trap and hard-style all day long under a blazing tropical sun, then DJ Snake is definitely from that planet. Hailing from Paris, France, the grammy-nominated producer exports a brand of party music so ferociously groovy that it instantly sets any party on fire, regardless of how steamy it may already be. 

His 2013 Jeffree's release "Bird Machine" is an infectious, staple trap anthem that brilliantly samples a bird whistle for the drop and has made a solid name for itself as one of the hottest songs of the year. It has received extensive play from the likes of Dillon Francis, Diplo, and Baauer, to name but a few, on some of the largest festival stages in the world. DJ Snake's ability to fuse fun, outrageous melodies with his genius trademark style makes it safe to say that we have a lot to be excited about when it comes to what we can expect next.
